Bots com \"Seu Mac\" ligado podem ver a: Bots with "Your Mac" turned on can see the screen, click, type and work in the allowed folders. The Stop button appears at the top of the screen while a bot is acting. After reinstalling the app, macOS may ask for permissions again.
Cada Mac em que você entrou fica ligado: Every Mac you sign in on is linked to your account. Bots use its AI accounts and computer while the app is open.
Cada servidor guarda o próprio login nes: Each server keeps its own sign-in on this Mac. Switching servers reloads the app without mixing bots, conversations and caches. Shortcut: ⌃⌘1 to ⌃⌘9.
